bio: He's a result of an old ruined experiment of a weird liquid called Vitamin X, one day a dad brought his kid to work, the kid placed his sonic collections disk near this experiment and it went inside the game corrupting it. Once the kid came back home to play the game he gets trapped in the game, giving this game and corrupted liquid a soul. This weird colorless sonic is the only real thing about this game and once someone plays the game, DSK gets the chance to kill these people and take thier soul to become insanely strong.
